entities.name: Hurshid Tojibaev

entities.summary: Khurshid Tadjibayev/Hoorshid Tojibaev is an Uzbekistani professional and former amateur boxer who competed at bantamweight at the 2008 Olympics and at lightweight at the 2016 Olympics.
